plans.title: Causal contact staging
plans.baselineOpportunity: Baseline labels do not specify simultaneous target and actual attachment visibility.
plans.proposedVisualConsequence: Keep intended and actual contact participants in one readable frame; clarity remains a hypothesis.
plans.materialDifference: Adds source-bound simultaneous causal staging, rather than a closer framing adjective.
preservedStoryAnchors: Mimi reaches toward the toy cabinet with a sticky note; instead of sticking to the cabinet, the note visibly clings to her finger
Mimi tries to peel the stuck note away with her other hand; the note splits into two
Mimi continues to pull; each pull doubles the number of sticky notes
Mimi sees herself in a mirror and screams
Mimi sneezes and the sticky notes fly off
risksReducedHypotheses: Explicit visibility may reduce causal ambiguity.
unknowns: Clarity and generator feasibility require rendered visual evidence.
